name: Thrali

lines.text: You will want the basin at night, after rain. The water goes silver and they come up. Ask me why and I will tell you I do not know.
My grandfather had a word for it. Thal-something. He is dead and I have half of it.
The far banks I cannot work. Water looks the same everywhere out there and it is not the same, and I have a family.

notes: Delta fisher, Kia by descent, half his grandfather's vocabulary lost. Gives the opening hook and is the first person the player can materially help. Would settle -- he has nothing holding him here but the fishing.
